requirement: Phone-only authentication and task confirmation without a native app session

authentication.signature: Validate X-Twilio-Signature over configured HTTPS public URL including exact challenge query and all form fields
authentication.independentReadback: Account SID, Call SID, inbound direction, destination, active call and registered caller contact must match canonical provider read

transport.logging: No raw form fields, OTPs, challenge tokens or phone numbers
transport.callbackQuery: challenge: opaque random token; server stores its hash only; signature includes exact query; reject extra query keys
transport.providerFields: Validate required identity fields and retain all submitted fields for signature verification; never treat arbitrary extra fields as authority

operations.purpose: signed caller number selects only one eligible verified account; explicit SMS request consent
check the already claimed Verify challenge; never accept a new destination
read exact stored task summary before collecting confirmation
atomically approve the bound digest once or cancel; never execute directly from digits

lifecycle.otp: consent -> durable send claim/quota -> Verify pending -> single check claim -> verified call grant or bounded retry/terminal unknown
lifecycle.approval: server task proposal -> independent fixed summary playback -> one-use DTMF response -> durable digest-bound approval -> separate once-only task execution
lifecycle.ambiguousPhone: No account-name disclosure or automatic account selection; receptionist fallback until a separate account-disambiguation policy is implemented
lifecycle.unknownProviderOutcome: No automatic resend or task retry

activationGates: pinned production metadata registration and independent readback
phone-scoped identity storage and current-permission enforcement
secure collector excludes AI media and recordings
Twilio/Vapi canonical call mapping survives controlled handoff
signed single-use task approval and database/API result readback
live controlled acceptance on intended number
